prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Proceed to view quick desktop control instructions for your new pet.", "Desktop Companion Controls Reference", "Here is how to interact with your pet on your desktop screen at any time.", "Right-click companion to open menu or hide desktop pet", "Double click companion to start a conversation"]
1: ["Preparing Your Pet for Desktop Spawn", "Your companion is being initialized and will appear directly on your desktop screen in a moment."]
2: ["Select Your Onboarding Pathway", "Decide how you would like to begin your desktop pet journey.", "Adopt Ready Companion", "Create Custom Pet"]
3: ["Secure Your Pet Account & Sync Data", "Signing in links your desktop companion to your account, ensuring your pets are safe when re-logging.", "Account sign-in prevents pet loss across desktop sessions."]
4: ["Use well-lit, front-facing photos to ensure high quality pet rendering.", "Clear lighting and distinct features produce the best desktop pet avatar results."]
5: ["Right-click your companion on the desktop anytime to hide it, manage settings, or open chat."]
6: ["Meet Your New Desktop Companion", "Bring an interactive pet companion straight to your screen in under two minutes.", "Start Quick Setup"]
7: ["Sign in to enable automatic cloud backup for all adopted pets.", "Cloud Progress Saved"]
8: ["Choose Your Starting Companion"]
9: ["A system notification will alert you as soon as your companion spawns on your desktop."]
